name: Mihrab
hero.title:
For every prayer,
and everything between.
hero.sub: Prayer times, the Qur’an, tilāwah, dua and dhikr — in one calm app.
accuracy.title: To the printed minute.
accuracy.sub: Each authority’s own method, calculated on your phone and checked against its published timetable.
accuracy.off:
times off the printed minute,
of {{total.timesCompact}} checked
accuracy.more: MUIS, JAKIM and Türkiye Takvimi as printed, and every major calculation method
accuracy.foot: Last checked {{total.checkedAtLong}}. Mihrab is independent and not affiliated with any of these authorities.
mushaf.title: The Madinah muṣḥaf, in tajwīd colour.
mushaf.sub: Drawn as text, sharp at any size. The recited word lights up; hold any word to hear it.
tilawah.title: Tilāwah, surah into surah.
tilawah.sub: 42 reciters. The page follows the recited word, with the screen off and a sleep timer.
understand.title: Translation, tafsīr and tajwīd.
understand.sub: Thirteen translations, classical tafsīr, and every tajwīd rule explained.
hifz.title: What you know by heart, kept.
hifz.sub: Each portion comes round again on its own cycle. Drills with repeats, and khatmah plans to the day.
remember.title: The remembrance between prayers.
remember.sub: Duas from Ḥiṣn al-Muslim, a tasbīḥ for after the prayer, and your fasts, kept.
day.title: Never miss a prayer.
day.sub: Adhan and full-screen alerts, widgets, the qibla, a month to share — and a log of every prayer.
month.title: The month ahead, and every prayer kept.
month.sub: A month of times to print or share as an image or PDF, and the log of your prayers and fasts beside it.
devices.title: On every device you own.
devices.sub: Android phones, tablets and foldables, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Linux and the web — kept in step by sync, with no account and no server of ours.
